steps.title: Protocol version and surface schema
steps.note: The protocol declares its schema version and the surfaces that can participate in a run: platform-web, desktop, gizzi, extension, and api.

steps.title: Run states
steps.note: BrowserRun.state uses a strict union: queued, running, approval_pending, paused, recovering, completed, failed, or cancelled.

steps.title: Action kinds
steps.note: ActionKind enumerates everything from navigate and click to tab.open, dialog.accept, and screenshot. Each maps to a concrete browser operation.

steps.title: Action intent structure
steps.note: An ActionIntent carries the run and session ids, the action kind, a human-readable reason, an optional target ref, and arbitrary input.

steps.title: Browser observations
steps.note: BrowserObservation captures the URL, title, format, text, element refs, artifacts, and redactions at a point in time.

steps.title: Browser event vocabulary
steps.note: BrowserEvent is the cross-surface event vocabulary: run lifecycle, action state changes, observations, approvals, artifacts, receipts, and handoffs.
